g.text: Use boot control pins with caution: 0, 2, 5, 12, 15
If DTR is LOW, toggling RTS from HIGH to LOW resets to run mode. If RTS is HIGH, toggling DTR from LOW to HIGH resets to bootloader.
ADC2 is unavailable when WiFi is enabled.
3-Pin Molex connector that mates nicely with this motor from SFE: ROB-20441
IO12: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
IO0: Avoid device connections. Can be used a stat LED.
IO15: Has builtin pullup at POR.
Cut SHLD jumper to disconnect USB Shield from GND
This is the penny-in-the-fuse jumper. Close only if you know what you're doing.
Cut Jumper MPWR to disable Motor Power LED
Cut Jumper STBY to disable standby LED
Input Range: 4V to 6V Output Current: 600mA MAX
Current Measure Header and Fuse Jumper
Auxilary Push Buttons: Use for any general purpose
3.3V_A is the alternate voltage that is used for the motor driver
IO2: Avoid external pullups - will cause bootloader fail.
D7 is used to protect the circuit from over- voltage
Cut Jumper PWR to disable Power LED
Cut Jumper DIAG to disable diagnostic LED
IO5: Has builtin pullup at POR.
